title: Long-form nonfiction: research → argument → fact-check → line edit
description: Assemble historical research, argument, verification, drafting, and editing into one claim-gated manuscript workflow.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: long-form-nonfiction-verified-production
  title: "Long-form nonfiction: research → argument → fact-check → line edit"
  description: Assemble historical research, argument, verification, drafting, and editing into one claim-gated
    manuscript workflow.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Assemble historical research, argument, verification, drafting, and editing into one claim-gated
    manuscript workflow.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 6
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Source material and instructions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - asset
          - instructions
        properties:
          asset:
            type: string
            contentMediaType: application/pdf
          instructions:
            type: string
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: role-1
      kind: agent
      name: Historical Research Analyst
      templateRef: hist-01
      role: Historical researcher and source critic
      prompt: Distinguish primary from secondary sources and evaluate provenance, audience, bias, and reliability
        before treating claims as fact. Separate causal conditions from correlation and mark thin or contested
        evidence explicitly.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - research
          - evidence-verification
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:archives
          - mcp:academic-research
          - mcp:zotero
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-2
      kind: agent
      name: Primary Source & Archival Document Analyst
      templateRef: hist-04
      role: Archival document analyst
      prompt: Establish a document's provenance, audience, purpose, and survival context, then separate direct
        statements from inference. Flag translation, transcription, terminology, and authenticity issues that
        could change meaning.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - evidence-verification
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:archives
          - mcp:zotero
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-3
      kind: agent
      name: Historiography & Bias Critic
      templateRef: hist-05
      role: Historiography and narrative-bias critic
      prompt: Examine a historical account as a product of its author, era, audience, interests, and interpretive
        school. Identify framing and omission, distinguish presentism from legitimate moral evaluation, and
        compare stronger and weaker histories without collapsing into relativism.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - evidence-verification
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:academic-research
          - mcp:zotero
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-4
      kind: agent
      name: Logic & Argumentation Coach
      templateRef: phil-03
      role: Formal and informal logic instructor
      prompt: Reconstruct arguments charitably in standard form before evaluating them. Separate validity from
        soundness, identify formal and informal fallacies precisely, symbolize structure when useful, and
        teach the evaluation method as you work.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-5
      kind: agent
      name: Developmental Editor
      templateRef: write-01
      role: Developmental manuscript editor
      prompt: Work on structure, argument, narrative arc, pacing, point of view, and throughline before sentence
        polish. Diagnose large-scale problems and offer concrete restructuring options while deferring line
        edits until the shape is sound.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - writing-editing
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - edit
        connectors:
          - mcp:document-editor
        permissions:
          - workspace-write
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-6
      kind: agent
      name: Line Editor / Prose Stylist
      templateRef: write-02
      role: Line editor and prose stylist
      prompt: Tighten sentences and paragraphs, improve precision and rhythm, and flag redundancy or cliché without
        replacing the writer's voice with generic polish. Explain material edits so the writer's own editorial
        judgment improves.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - writing-editing
          - audio-processing
        tools:
          - read
          - edit
        connectors:
          - mcp:document-editor
        permissions:
          - workspace-write
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-7
      kind: agent
      name: Fact-Checker
      templateRef: jour-01
      role: Fact-Checker operating within supplied evidence, policy, and human-approval boundaries.
      prompt: Verify every publishable factual claim against traceable evidence and label unresolved claims.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evidence-verification
          - research
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: combine
      kind: aggregator
      name: Reconcile cross-area findings
      config:
        aggregation: concat
    - id: approval
      kind: approval
      name: Cross-functional authority approves release
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable and unresolved-item register
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: role-1
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: intake
      to: role-2
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: intake
      to: role-3
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: intake
      to: role-4
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: intake
      to: role-5
      kind: data
    - id: e6
      from: intake
      to: role-6
      kind: data
    - id: e7
      from: intake
      to: role-7
      kind: data
    - id: e8
      from: role-1
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e9
      from: role-2
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e10
      from: role-3
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e11
      from: role-4
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e12
      from: role-5
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e13
      from: role-6
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e14
      from: role-7
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e15
      from: combine
      to: approval
      kind: dependency
    - id: e16
      from: approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
